Human in the loop review for outbound emails (especially during testing phase) 3. Quick onboarding/offboarding email addresses for agents within minutes 4. excerpt_i18n.en: On the 11th, Google's Threat Intelligence Group released a report stating that it had, for the first time, discovered cyber attackers using artificial intelligence (AI) technology to develop a "zero-day vulnerability" attack tool. In the report, Google's Threat Intelligence Group noted that this "zero-day vulnerability" attack tool targets a "popular open-source, web-based system management tool," is implemented using Python scripts, and can bypass two-factor authentication. Google stated that it has notified the affected company of the vulnerability and blocked the related threat activities. (Xinhua News Agency)

Las vulnerabilidades de día cero son fallos de seguridad que los fabricantes de software aún no han descubierto o no tienen tiempo de reparar. En el informe, el grupo de inteligencia de amenazas de Google indicó que esta herramienta de ataque de día cero está dirigida a una "herramienta popular de gestión de sistemas basada en web y de código abierto", se implementa mediante scripts de Python y puede eludir la autenticación de doble factor. excerpt_i18n.en: From 2025 to 2026, if asked which research direction in generative AI deserves the most attention, Flow Matching is an unavoidable answer. Since last year, this name has frequently appeared in top conference papers, been repeatedly discussed in the industry, and directly compared with diffusion models that dominated image generation for five years. Flow Matching essentially replaces the stochastic differential equation path of diffusion models with an ordinary differential equation (ODE) path, allowing the transition from noise to images without relying on hundreds of iterative steps, thereby theoretically achieving more efficient generation. However, from theoretical feasibility to engineering implementation, countless technical details lie in between—how to design the training objective, how to choose the architecture, and how to balance speed and quality—each step is fraught with challenges. It is at this juncture that He Kaiming's team has intensively delivered a multi-faceted response. AI Tech Review summarized the papers published by He Kaiming's team at the recent CVPR conference: In May 2025, they proposed MeanFlow, introducing the "mean velocity field" to generative modeling for the first time; later that year, BiFlow achieved a 700x acceleration within the normalizing flow framework, pushing FID to 2.39; around the same time, Improved MeanFlow (iMF) reduced single-step FID to 1.72 through three systematic fixes, marking the first time without distillation.
excerpt_i18n.es: De 2025 a 2026, si hablamos de las direcciones de investigación más destacadas en el campo de la IA generativa, el Flow Matching es una respuesta inevitable. Desde el año pasado, este nombre ha comenzado a aparecer con frecuencia en artículos de conferencias de primer nivel, ha sido debatido repetidamente en la industria y se ha comparado directamente con los modelos de difusión que han dominado el campo de la generación de imágenes durante cinco años. El llamado Flow Matching, en esencia, reemplaza la ruta estocástica de ecuaciones diferenciales de los modelos de difusión con una ruta de ecuaciones diferenciales ordinarias (ODE path), permitiendo que la transformación de datos de ruido a imágenes ya no dependa de cientos de iteraciones, logrando así una generación teóricamente más eficiente. According to a report released by TrendForce in February this year, traditional DRAM contract prices in the first quarter of 2026 rose by 90% to 95% compared to the fourth quarter of 2025; NAND Flash contract prices in the first quarter of 2026 increased by 55% to 60% from the previous quarter. However, starting in late March, the market suddenly shifted, with panic selling in the DRAM spot market. Spot prices for DDR4 and DDR5 memory modules dropped significantly. Data shows that the price of mainstream 32GB DDR5 kits fell from around 2,999 yuan in mid-March to approximately 2,200 yuan, a monthly decline of nearly 27%. He led the development of the distributed storage system ParaStor and the all-flash storage system FlashNexus, both of which have repeatedly topped global performance rankings. He has deep practical experience in key scenarios such as AI inference and high-frequency financial trading. Wang Wenhao: Changhong Jia

Los precios al contado de los módulos de memoria DDR4 y DDR5 cayeron considerablemente. items.raw_excerpt: 今天，大模型圈再次被点燃，这一次的火花来自前 OpenAI 应用研究负责人翁荔（Lilian Weng）。她创立的Thinking Machines Lab（TML）首次公布的技术愿景，直指人机交互的终极形态——一个能与人类进行「全双工」（Full-Duplex）实时对话的 AI 模型。   然而，当 TML 那支展示着无缝、主动交互能力的 Demo 视频在网络上流传时，许多 AI 领域的从业者却产生了一种强烈的「既视感」——因为 TML 描绘的那个未来，早在三个月前，就已被中国公司「面壁智能」的 MiniCPM-o 4.5 以开源的形式，带到了现实。 先看「边看边听边说」的全模态实时交互效果—— 这是 MiniCPM-o 4.5 的效果，模型可以实时观察周围并对环境进行描述输出，主动反应表现一流： 这是 TML 时隔 3 个月后发布的模型效果： 这不仅是一次简单的「撞车」，更像是一场跨越太平洋的技术共识。它不仅验证了下一代 AI 交互的技术路径，也让我们重新审视中国 AI 力量在全球创新版图中的位置。   一场不约而同的交互革命：打破「对讲机」模式 要理解这场技术共识的深刻性，首先要明白 TML 和面壁智能共同挑战的敌人是什么——延续至今的「回合制」（turn-based）交互范式。 从 Siri 到各类语音助手，再到 GPT-4o 的语音模式，我们与 AI 的交流更像是使用一部「对讲机」：你说完，等待「滴」的一声，然后它回应。 这背后是一套名为「语音活动检测」（VAD）的机制在主导，它像一个裁判，严格划分着你和 AI 的发言轮次。这种模式，与人类自然对话中那种你来我往、信息流交织的状态，相去甚远。 而面壁智能与 TML 的共同洞察是：真正的自然交互，必须打破这种轮次限制，进入一个「全双工」的流式处理时代。 面壁智能的先行：这正是面壁智能
